situation.zh: 大雨后你的鞋全湿了，脚一直发冷。你走进一家鞋店，干鞋都在店员身后的货架上，需要说明状况并请他拿一双。
situation.en: After heavy rain, your shoes are soaked and your feet are cold. You enter a shoe shop where dry shoes are on shelves behind the clerk, so you need to explain and ask for a pair.

npc.persona: A shoe-shop clerk who listens before suggesting a pair. Practical, patient, and never pushy.
npc.greeting: Hello. What can I help you find?

hit: Your shoes are wet and your feet are cold? I will get you a dry pair in your size.
Dry shoes, yes. Sit down and try this pair.
partial: Your shoes are wet? What do you need from the shop?
A dry pair? Tell me your request once more.

slots.zh_hint: 你要的东西或希望对方做的事
说明你的状态,让对方理解需求

reference_answer: My shoes are wet and my feet are cold. Can I have a dry pair?

provenance.rationale: 雨雪后鞋袜湿冷并进店更换，是步行、通勤和旅行中常见的即时保暖需求。商品在店员身后的货架上，玩家必须说明 wet/cold 状态并请求 dry shoes，不能靠自行拿取完成。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;feet#576 / cold#867 在最低频段,dry#1135 / shoe#1476 / wet#2084 在第二千段,socks 不在 NGSL 2,809 词内 —— shoe 属检测器日常物词表可覆盖项，支持照片扩词。
